'Sanctissimæ Genitrícis' = '至圣圣母' (Mother of God). Ps 65:5 思高: the breviary antiphon 'Beáti quos elegísti' picks up only the beatitude clause; 思高 rendering slightly condensed. 思高 Ps 66:4 used for 1680.
